# convexDistanceTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [convexDistanceTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/convexDistanceTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The distance of convex shapes by exudyn.cUtilities.Distance (#3317): spheres, capsules, cylinders, boxes,
#           triangles and convex point sets against closed-form distances and penetration depths - crossed capsules,
#           parallel and crossed cylinders, boxes, a sphere against a triangle -, the analytic sphere-cylinder distance
#           against GJK and EPA, and random pairs of all shapes: shape 1 moved back along the normal by the distance
#           touches shape 0. Wrong shapes are refused. The result is the number of passed checks plus the sum of some
#           distances.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-07
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.cUtilities import ConvexShape, Distance
from exudyn.rigidBodyUtilities import RotationMatrixX, RotationMatrixY, RotationMatrixZ
import numpy as np
from exudyn import cMath

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

def HT(position, rotation=np.eye(3)):
    return exu.HT(rotation=rotation, translation=position)

checks = []
sumDistances = 0.

#closed-form cases: shape0, HT0, shape1, HT1, distance, normal (None: not checked)
box = ConvexShape('Box', size=[1, 1, 1])
capsule = ConvexShape('Capsule', radius=0.1, length=2)
cylinder = ConvexShape('Cylinder', radius=0.2, length=1)
sphere = ConvexShape('Sphere', radius=0.1)
triangle = ConvexShape('Triangle', points=[[0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]])
cases = []
for dx in [1.5, 1., 0.9, 0.2]: #boxes apart, touching, penetrating by 0.1 and 0.8
    cases += [(box, HT([0, 0, 0]), box, HT([dx, 0.1, 0.05]), dx - 1, [1, 0, 0])]
for dz in [1, 0.2, 0.1]: #crossed capsules along x and y
    cases += [(capsule, HT([0, 0, 0], RotationMatrixY(np.pi/2)), capsule, HT([0, 0, dz], RotationMatrixX(np.pi/2)), dz - 0.2, [0, 0, 1])]
for d in [1, 0.4, 0.3]: #parallel cylinders, shifted along their axis
    cases += [(cylinder, HT([0, 0, 0]), cylinder, HT([d, 0, 0.3]), d - 0.4, [1, 0, 0])]
for dz in [1.5, 0.5, 0.3]: #crossed cylinders
    cases += [(cylinder, HT([0, 0, 0], RotationMatrixY(np.pi/2)), cylinder, HT([0, 0, dz], RotationMatrixX(np.pi/2)), dz - 0.4, [0, 0, 1])]
for (p, d, n) in [([0.2, 0.2, 0.5], 0.4, [0, 0, -1]), ([0.2, 0.2, 0.05], -0.05, [0, 0, -1]), ([-1, -1, 0], np.sqrt(2) - 0.1, [1/np.sqrt(2), 1/np.sqrt(2), 0])]:
    cases += [(sphere, HT(p), triangle, HT([0, 0, 0]), d, n)]
cases += [(sphere, HT([0, 0, 0]), ConvexShape('Sphere', radius=0.2), HT([0, 0, 0.1]), -0.2, [0, 0, 1])]
error = 0.
errorNormal = 0.
for (s0, H0, s1, H1, dExact, nExact) in cases:
    (d, p0, p1, n) = Distance(s0, H0, s1, H1)
    error = max(error, abs(d - dExact))
    errorNormal = max(errorNormal, np.max(np.abs(n - nExact)))
    sumDistances += d
exu.Print('closed-form cases: largest error of the distance', error, ', of the normal', errorNormal)
checks += [error < 1e-12, errorNormal < 1e-6] #the normal at the side of a cylinder to about 1e-7

#the analytic sphere-cylinder distance against GJK and EPA
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
def RandomRotation():
    return RotationMatrixZ(rng.uniform(-3, 3)) @ RotationMatrixY(rng.uniform(-3, 3)) @ RotationMatrixX(rng.uniform(-3, 3))
error = 0.
for i in range(200):
    H1 = HT(rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, 3), RandomRotation())
    s0 = ConvexShape('Sphere', radius=rng.uniform(0.01, 0.3))
    H0 = HT(rng.uniform(-1, 1, 3))
    dAnalytic = Distance(s0, H0, cylinder, H1)[0]
    dGJK = Distance(s0, H0, cylinder, H1, analytic=False)[0]
    error = max(error, abs(dAnalytic - dGJK))
exu.Print('sphere-cylinder, analytic against GJK and EPA: largest difference', error)
checks += [error < 1e-9]

#random pairs: shape 1 moved by -d n touches shape 0, and is 0.01 apart after moving it back by 0.01
def RandomShape(k):
    if k == 0: return ConvexShape('Sphere', radius=rng.uniform(0.05, 0.4))
    if k == 1: return ConvexShape('Capsule', radius=rng.uniform(0.05, 0.3), length=rng.uniform(0, 1))
    if k == 2: return ConvexShape('Cylinder', radius=rng.uniform(0.05, 0.4), length=rng.uniform(0.05, 1))
    if k == 3: return ConvexShape('Box', size=rng.uniform(0.05, 1, 3))
    if k == 4: return ConvexShape('Triangle', points=rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, (3, 3)))
    return ConvexShape('Points', points=rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5, (12, 3)))
errorTouching = 0.
errorApart = 0.
for k0 in range(6):
    for k1 in range(6):
        for i in range(20):
            s0, s1 = RandomShape(k0), RandomShape(k1)
            H0 = HT(rng.uniform(-0.3, 0.3, 3), RandomRotation())
            A1 = RandomRotation()
            position1 = rng.uniform(-0.8, 0.8, 3)
            (d, p0, p1, n) = Distance(s0, H0, s1, HT(position1, A1))
            if d > 1e-6: #the closest points
                errorApart = max(errorApart, abs(cMath.norm(p1 - p0) - d), cMath.norm((p1 - p0)/d - n))
            errorTouching = max(errorTouching, abs(Distance(s0, H0, s1, HT(position1 - d*n, A1))[0]))
            errorApart = max(errorApart, abs(Distance(s0, H0, s1, HT(position1 - (d - 0.01)*n, A1))[0] - 0.01))
exu.Print('random pairs: largest distance after moving to contact', errorTouching, ', 0.01 apart', errorApart)
checks += [errorTouching < 1e-6, errorApart < 1e-9]

#refused
for (shapeType, arguments) in [('Cone', {}), ('Sphere', {}), ('Box', {'radius': 1, 'size': [1, 1, 1]}),
                               ('Cylinder', {'radius': 0.1}), ('Triangle', {'points': [[0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0]]})]:
    try:
        ConvexShape(shapeType, **arguments)
        checks += [False]
    except ValueError:
        checks += [True]

u = sum(checks) + sumDistances
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of convexDistanceTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
